episodes.synopsis: In the year 2199, alien beings attack the last of Earth’s space fleet who are protecting a secret mission. Ace pilot Susumu Kodai retrieves an item on Mars that could save the human race, but learns tragic news about his brother.
episodes.title: Messenger of Iscandar

episodes.synopsis: Mankind finally completes its first interstellar spaceship, the Yamato, which will be sent with a crew to a distant planet. But enemies won’t let them leave Earth so easily.
episodes.title: Toward a Sea of Stars

episodes.synopsis: After their space warp goes awry, the Yamato lands on a floating continent to make repairs. When they discover where the land comes from, the Gamilas attack.
episodes.title: Escape from the Jupiter Sphere

episodes.synopsis: Stopping on Saturn’s moon, Susumu investigates a distress call. But a crashed ship isn’t the only thing he finds.
episodes.title: Gravestone on a Frozen Field

episodes.synopsis: When the Yamato attacks a Gamilan  base on Pluto, the crew realizes that they’ll have to take more drastic measures to outsmart their enemies.
episodes.title: The Trap on All Sides

episodes.synopsis: After the recon pilots locate the main Gamilan base, the Yamato has an opportunity to counterattack.
episodes.title: The Sun Sets on Pluto

episodes.synopsis: As the Yamato prepares to leave the solar system, the crew is given a last chance to say goodbye to their loved ones on Earth.
episodes.title: Farewell to the Solar System

episodes.synopsis: With Gamilan forces hot on their trail, the Yamato must navigate around the burning solar flares of a star.
episodes.title: Wish Upon a Star

episodes.synopsis: The crew reassembles a Gamilan android found on Saturn’s moon, and the Yamato’s own robot befriends it.
episodes.title: Clockwork Prisoner

episodes.synopsis: When the Yamato and a Gamilan ship are trapped in a dimensional rift, their only chance of escape lies in a ceasefire.
episodes.title: Graveyard of the Universe

episodes.synopsis: Trapped on the Yamato, a Gamilan pilot reveals the truth behind the first contact with earthlings.
episodes.title: A World I Once Saw

episodes.synopsis: An extra-dimensional vessel attacks the Yamato as it approaches the edge of the Milky Way.
episodes.title: What Lies Beyond

episodes.synopsis: Having found shelter in a cluster of asteroids, the crew makes an important discovery about the Gamilas’ tactics.
episodes.title: The Wolf from Another Dimension

episodes.synopsis: Kodai and Yuki return to a seemingly empty Yamato. Attempts to locate the crew are hindered by a foe who can control memories.
episodes.title: The Whisper of the Witch

episodes.synopsis: Unbeknownst to General Domel, plots are unfolding on his homeworld. Meanwhile, he plans an ambush of epic proportions against the Yamato.
episodes.title: Point of No Return

episodes.synopsis: Resupply and damage control turns into mutiny when a planet is discovered that’s seemingly a valid alternative to Earth.
episodes.title: A Choice for the Future

episodes.synopsis: An ancient warp gate presents an opportunity to get the Yamato back on schedule. Sanada reveals a secret regarding the Yamato’s automatic navigation system.
episodes.title: Out of the Forest of Memory

episodes.synopsis: Using the warp gate, the Yamato must bypass the planet Balun. But they’ll have to punch through a massive Gamilan fleet if they want to arrive at the Large Magellanic Cloud in one piece.
episodes.title: Over the Black Light

episodes.synopsis: Attempting to get ahead of the enemy, Okita commands the Yamato through a dangerous section of nebula. But newly reinstated General Domel is hot on their trail.
episodes.title: They're Coming!

episodes.synopsis: The Gamilans set their ambush into motion. The two commanders, Domel and Okita, vie for ultimate victory and survival.
episodes.title: Under a Rainbow Sun

episodes.synopsis: Yuki is taken to the Gamilan prison planet of Leptapoda. Kodai is sent to the same planet to scout out supplies for the Yamato.
episodes.title: Prison Planet 17

episodes.synopsis: After discovering that Iscandar and Gamilas are twin planets, the crew of the Yamato prepare to warp into enemy territory.
episodes.title: The Planet That We Head For

episodes.synopsis: With a Wave Motion Gun in Gamilan possession, the Yamato’s only option is to take the fight to Gamilas’ capital. Meanwhile, Kodai is given permission to rescue Yuki.
episodes.title: One Man's War

episodes.synopsis: With Desler defeated, the Yamato lands on Iscandar in hopes that Queen Starsha will grant them the Cosmo Reverser. Kodai finally uncovers the fate of his brother.
episodes.title: The Distant Promised Land

episodes.synopsis: En route back to Earth, the crew of the Yamato have a final confrontation with Desler.
episodes.title: The Forever War

episodes.synopsis: Celebrations are in order as the Yamato draws closer to Earth. But with Yuki in critical condition, only a miracle can ensure a happy return home.
episodes.title: Memories of the Blue Planet
